description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component within the application, testing presentation logic based on user defaults and app state.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of tests for the OnboardingStateStore logic, verifying UI presentation conditions and persistent state updates.

classes.name: TestDefaults
classes.description: A helper structure for creating and managing user defaults during testing.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Asserts that onboarding will be presented on a fresh app launch when not connected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Verifies onboarding is skipped when the app detects a connection.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Confirms marking onboarding as completed persists the mode and prevents presentation.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Tests that the first run introduction is shown initially and then its state persists.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Ensures that resetting onboarding state clears completion and intro flags.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a unique UserDefaults suite for testing purposes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes all stored preferences in the custom UserDefaults suite.
